note: Literature establishes that NFU1 variants cause a spectrum from severe infantile MMDS1 to hereditary spastic paraplegia with residual enzymatic activity.

evidence.text: The literature indicates an NFU1-related disease continuum ranging from severe MMDS1 to complex hereditary spastic paraplegia phenotypes with residual metabolic/enzymatic activity.
